text_block_list.text:
But when I get first place, you'd better
praise me
even more!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I'll never, eeever be satisfied!
Ehe! ☆
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: After all... I've gotta be the fastest, the best, and the cutest! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
With that, Каррен Тян promises not
only to get
first place in the next race
but to look cute doing
it too!

I can see the fire burning in her eyes as
she says
that.
